ValidationRule.description: Once sent, bill figures are hard-locked at the database level. Reopening via the service layer unlocks them; direct edit attempts from unauthorised staff are blocked.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(NOT(ISNEW()), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), "Sent"), OR(ISCHANGED(Total_Amount__c), ISCHANGED(Total_Units_Consumed__c), ISCHANGED(Supply_Charge__c), ISCHANGED(Period_Start__c), ISCHANGED(Period_End__c), ISCHANGED(Split_Method__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This bill has been sent. Ask a user with permission to reopen it before changing the figures.
